title: National Account Manager (Retail) - Myprotein
description:
About THG 

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition. 

Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition. 

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.  

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for? 

Role: National Account Manager

Area / Brand: Retail \ Myprotien

Reporting to: B2B Sales Director

Location: THG ICON 1, 7-9 Sunbank Lane, WA15 0AF (Hybrid)

Life at THG Nutrition

THG Nutrition is home to some of the world’s most trusted and best-loved wellbeing and nutrition brands, including Myprotein, the world’s largest online sports nutrition brand, alongside Myvegan, Myvitamins and MP Activewear.

Our brands and people exist to break boundaries — to power and empower those who want more. We move fast, challenge convention, and back ourselves to win. These values shape how we work every day.

 

About the role:

We are seeking an ambitious and commercially focused National Account Manager to drive growth across the Retail and Grocery channel. This role will be responsible for managing key national retail accounts, developing strategic customer partnerships, and delivering sustainable sales and profit growth across major grocery retailers.

The successful candidate will have strong FMCG experience, exceptional relationship management skills, and a proven ability to execute commercial plans within a fast-paced retail environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and develop relationships with key Grocery and Retail customers across the UK market.
  • Deliver sales, margin, and distribution targets in line with annual business objectives.
  • Create and execute Joint Business Plans (JBPs) to support long-term customer growth.
  • Lead commercial negotiations including pricing, promotional activity, range reviews, and new product listings.
  • Identify opportunities to grow category performance, increase market share, and improve customer profitability.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, category, supply chain, finance, and demand planning teams.
  • Analyse customer performance, market trends, and competitor activity to inform commercial strategy.
  • Manage forecasting, promotional planning, and account performance reporting.
  • Build strong relationships with buyers, category managers, and senior retail stakeholders.
  • Support the successful launch and distribution of new products across retail channels.

Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience in National Account Management within FMCG or Consumer Goods.
  • Experience managing major Grocery or Retail accounts.
  • Strong commercial acumen with a track record of delivering growth targets.
  • Excellent negotiation and influencing skills.
  • Strong analytical and forecasting capability.
  • Ability to build trusted customer relationships at multiple levels.
  • Highly organised with excellent project and time management skills.
  • Comfortable working within a fast-paced and commercially driven environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience managing accounts such as Tesco, Sainsbury’s, Morrisons, Asda, Waitrose, Co-op, or Ocado.
  • Understanding of category management principles and retailer processes.
  • Experience within health & wellness, snacking, beverages, or high-growth FMCG brands.
  • Familiarity with syndicated data platforms such as Nielsen or Circana.

 

 

What’s in it for me? 

Career Development 

  • Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team. 
  • Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider. 

Enhanced Leave 

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays. 
  • Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us! 
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.  
  • Up to 10 days compassionate leave. 
  • Buy back up to 3 days each year. 
  • Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months. 

Wellbeing Support 

  • Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.
     
  • Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.  
  • State-of-the-art on-site gym. 
  • Access to our on-site physio. 

Other Perks 

  • Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme. 
  • Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.  
  • Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands. 

  • On-site staff shop.
     
  • Know someone who would be perfect for THG? Refer them and get up to £1000 when they pass their probation. 
  • Anniversary gifts when you hit 5 and 10 years of service.

About THG Labs

THG acquired Acheson & Acheson in 2018 to bring full service, product development & manufacturing in-house to supply innovative branded and THG Beauty Brand products to the industry. In 2022 Acheson & Acheson became THG Labs. Capabilities include:

  • In-house market knowledge & trends
  • End-to-end service from idea generation through to manufacturing and launch
  • Technical, commercial and production expertise
  • Outstanding customer service

About the Role

We’re looking for a proactive and versatile Maintenance Engineer with strong mechanical expertise and sound electrical knowledge to join our fast-paced engineering team. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining, diagnosing, and repairing a wide range of production and site equipment to ensure maximum operational efficiency and minimal downtime.

As a Multi-Skilled Engineer you will:

  • Carry out planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and reactive maintenance on mechanical and electrical systems, including conveyors, gearboxes, pumps, motors, bearings, pneumatic systems, hydraulic equipment, and automated machinery.
  • Diagnose mechanical faults and complete repairs in accordance with safety standards and manufacturers’ guidelines.
  • Undertake equipment strip-downs, component replacements, alignments, adjustments, and rebuilds.
  • Perform basic electrical fault-finding and safely isolate equipment when required.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to engineering projects aimed at improving equipment reliability, performance, and efficiency.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records using the company’s CMMS system.
  • Ensure compliance with all relevant Health & Safety, environmental, and quality standards.
  • Provide technical support and collaborate closely with production and operations teams.

  • Time-served apprenticeship or relevant engineering qualification (NVQ Level 3, ONC, or HNC) in Mechanical or Multi-Skilled Maintenance Engineering.
  • Proven experience in a similar maintenance engineering role within a manufacturing, FMCG, or industrial environment.
  • Strong mechanical fault-finding and diagnostic skills, with practical experience working on bearings, gearboxes, pumps, conveyors, pneumatics, and hydraulics.
  • Sound electrical knowledge, including motors, sensors, control systems, and safe electrical isolation.
  • Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, technical diagrams, and schematics.
  • Excellent problem-solving ability and attention to detail.
  • Flexible, team-oriented, and capable of working independently under pressure.

Desirable:

  • Electrical qualification or experience undertaking basic electrical maintenance and fault-finding.
  • Experience working with automated systems, robotics, or packaging machinery.
  • Welding, fabrication, machining, or mechanical fitting experience.
  • Knowledge of lean maintenance or continuous improvement practices, including TPM, Kaizen, and 5S.

Career Development

  • Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.

  • Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us!
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.
  • Up to 10 days compassionate leave.
  • Buy back up to 3 days each year.
  • Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months.

Wellbeing Support

  • Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP (Manchester Head Office).
  • Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.
  • Access to our on-site physio (Manchester Head Office).

Other Perks

  • Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands.

About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

The role

This is a full-time Collections Administrator role with hybrid working (minimum 3 days per week in the Milton Keynes office).

The role will be responsible for managing delinquent accounts as they flow through the collections strategy. Day-to-day tasks include administration and reconciliation tasks, updating case management systems, reviewing and processing both hard copy and digital correspondence and liaising with third parties. No prior collections or financial services experience is required — we’ll provide full training on regulation, systems and processes; what matters most is the right attitude, judgement and attention to detail.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who has, or is keen to develop, the following:

  • No prior collections or financial services experience necessary — full training will be provided on FCA regulation (including CONC7), DPA requirements and our internal processes

  • Willing to learn about the broad range of debt solutions, e.g. Payment Arrangements, DMPs, IVAs, Trust Deeds, DROs, Breathing Space etc.

  • Good Microsoft Excel skills, or a willingness to quickly get up to speed with VLOOKUP, Pivot tables, linking sheets etc.

  • Strong attention to detail and consistency, with the discipline to follow pre-defined procedures across multiple IT systems

  • A team player who will help as required to deliver tasks within the team SLAs

  • Familiar with KPIs and targets and quality assurance requirements

  • A flexible team member who can adapt quickly to changing requirements and business demands

What you'll be doing

  • Collections administration, managing delinquent accounts as they flow through the collections strategy

  • Reconciliation of customer loans and completing admin work in line with pre-defined procedures

  • Updating case management systems

  • Reviewing and processing hard copy and digital correspondence

  • Liaising with customers and their third party representatives, e.g., Field suppliers, debt collection agencies, insolvency portfolio managers

  • Assessing customer affordability using our industry leading Open Banking software

    What we offer

  • Everyone owns a piece of the company - equity

  • 25 days’ holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

  • 2 paid volunteering days per year

  • Hybrid with 3 days a week in the office

  • One month paid sabbatical after 4 years

  • Employee loan

  • Free gym membership

  • Team wellness budget to be active together - set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

Multi-entity European operations: Swiss/EU accounting, VAT, transfer pricing, cross-border payroll. Venture debt, structured financing, or buy-side M&A experience. What’s in it for you? Meaningful equity upside - a package built for a founder-like profile in a capital-efficient business, where the value you help create is value you share in. doinstruct builds software that helps organizations train and enable their frontline teams, the people in factories, logistics, and service environments who are hardest to reach with conventional L&D. Our customers are manufacturers, industrial operators, and traditional enterprises.

As a key part of our marketing team, you’ll get to flex your strategic, research, and creative skills writing and creating content with two specific goals: Educate our audience (Thought leadership) and convert them (Acquisition). You own both end-to-end.

You will create high-value content in the form of blog articles, case studies, landing page copy, and white papers, collaborating closely with internal subject matter experts. For shoots and videos, you’ll use your storytelling superpowers to develop concepts and manage external production partners.

AI is an expected part of your workflow. You leverage the speed and efficiency technology affords with the taste only humans possess to create credible content worth reading.

If you have a journalistic curiosity, understand B2B audiences, and know how to build a content engine from the ground up - let’s talk!

🎯 What you'll own

  • Translate frontline realities, industry insights, trends, analysis, and product communication into content that resonates with buyers who don't live in generic SaaS marketing.

  • Produce German-first content (that’s also translated in English), and work closely with the wider GTM team on broader copy requirements like campaigns and sales decks.

  • Brand tone of voice, ensuring consistency and differentiation

🙋 Who you are

  • You've produced content professionally and have a portfolio or examples.

  • You have a journalistic mindset - able to interview subject matter experts to extract insights, hooks, and stories.

  • You're fluent in German, comfortable writing and speaking it professionally. You’re also comfortable collaborating, presenting, and working at a professional proficiency in English.

  • You’ve already restructured how you work around AI - whether that's tracking AI visibility with something like Profound or Peec AI, producing multilingual content with tools like ElevenLabs or HeyGen, or researching with Perplexity instead of defaulting to Google. You're not maintaining an existing content machine; you're bringing a new brand strategy to life; experimenting; and building a content function. That means real ambiguity, but also a chance to have outsized impact on a rapidly scaling business.

3 months You've got a content production rhythm running across formats, you understand our frontline buyer personas firsthand, and you’re identifying opportunities.

🌟 What we do & why we do it

Founded in 2021 in Osnabrück, Germany, doinstruct is on a mission to empower the backbone of our society - the frontline workforce - by making workplaces safer, more compliant, and more efficient. We don’t just improve training; we redefine how industries onboard and upskill their teams.

The problem? Outdated, inefficient training methods that fail to meet the needs of the deskless workforce - the 80% of global workers overlooked by traditional learning solutions. We saw the gap and built a seamless, mobile-first platform that makes onboarding, training, and compliance effortless, multilingual, and accessible - anytime, anywhere.

At doinstruct, we don’t accept the status quo. We innovate, we challenge, we build. Our vision is bold: Operational excellence for frontline teams starts here. We cut through the noise of clunky, ineffective training with an engaging, user-friendly experience available in 35+ languages - no downloads, no passwords - just instant access to the skills that drive industries forward.

🚀 Join us if you’re ready to build something extraordinary. We’re growing fast and looking for ambitious minds who thrive in a fast-paced, high-impact environment. If you’re passionate about solving big problems, shaping the future of workplace learning, and working alongside a driven team that moves fast and thinks big, doinstruct is where you belong.

___

The role

You'll sit next to doinstruct's founders, and you decide which workflows move to Claude agents, what ships to production, and what gets killed. Every project you take on has to clear one bar: a 3-5x return in hours saved, revenue generated, or headcount avoided. If it doesn't clear that bar, we don't build it.

This is full-time, in-office in Prenzlauer Berg at least 4 days a week, starting as soon as you can move.

🛠️ What you'll do

  • Work directly with Charlotte and Mona on cross-functional initiatives across GTM, Product, and Ops.

  • Find the highest-leverage workflows in the company, redesign them around Claude agents, MCPs, and Skills, ship them, and measure the lift.

  • Build the automations yourself, in Claude Code, GitHub, n8n or Zapier, and directly inside HubSpot and Planhat.

  • Own launches end-to-end: brief, plan, execute, retro.

🤖 How we work

  • Pick your Claude tool by what the problem needs: Cowork for anything multi-step and messy, Code when something has to run, Sonnet or Opus for the genuinely hard stuff, Haiku for volume.

  • Anything you'd do twice gets checked into GitHub as a skill or an agent, so it's still there after you move on.

  • "Claude said so" doesn't fly here. "Claude said so, here's how I checked" does.

  • You don't need a CS degree. You do need to be comfortable opening a terminal and figuring it out.

📈 Where this role can grow

Three tracks so far: become the go-to person for one function (sales, marketing, partnerships, or CX), go deep on AI as a senior IC shaping how the whole company builds with it, or grow into Chief of Staff and take on broader ownership across the business, a role that doesn't exist yet. Which one depends on what you're pulled toward and what the company needs when we get there.

🧭 Who you are

  • 1-2 years of operator experience, including internships, at a top startup, consultancy, VC/PE, or investment bank. Extra credit if you've been a Founder's Associate, Chief of Staff, GTM engineer, or founded something yourself.

  • Top 5% of your peers, provable through founding experience, a leadership track record, grades, or an unusual builder résumé.

  • AI-native, not AI-curious. You already run Claude, Cursor, and n8n day to day, and you've shipped at least one automation that's still running in production.

  • You measure your own impact in hours saved and revenue generated, not in slides produced or meetings held.

  • You'd rather write a one-page memo than book a meeting to explain it.

  • Real empathy for blue-collar and frontline work. Time in food, manufacturing, construction, or logistics is a strong plus, not a requirement.

  • Fluent in German and English. Berlin-based or ready to relocate within 4-6 weeks.

🎁 What we offer

  • Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of frontline workers and shows up in company metrics inside your first quarter.

  • Full autonomy from day one on projects that would normally sit with someone five years more senior.

  • The AI tooling budget you'd expect from a company that means it: Claude Max, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, n8n or Zapier, and no cap on token spend.

  • Great salary, a Belonio card for meals and mobility, Wellpass or Urban Sports Club, a language-learning budget.

  • Backed by over €25M in Seed & Series A funding from HV Capital, Creandum, HTGF, and D11Z, so the runway matches the ambition.

____

At doinstruct, you'll have the chance to use your skills and help shape our growing start-up. We value a friendly work environment, open communication, and support your personal and professional growth every step of the way.

Even if you don't tick all of the boxes, but you are motivated and want to work with us, you are very welcome to apply.

We embrace diversity and hire people based on their ability to perform a job. People of any race, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, political opinion, or marital status are welcome at doinstruct.

  • 🗣️ Honesty – We value transparency and direct, constructive feedback. Open communication helps us learn faster, grow stronger, and build trust.

  • 🌟 Ownership – We take full responsibility for our work, moving with urgency and independence. We don’t wait for solutions—we create them. Mistakes are learning opportunities, and we embrace them as part of our growth.

 

🤝 How we work

raw.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As Harvey scales its pre-sales function across EMEA, we are hiring a Legal Engineer Manager to lead and grow the team in Munich. This role exists to provide senior leadership and strategic direction to a team of Legal Engineers who sit at the heart of Harvey's commercial motion - bringing legal credibility, product expertise, and consultative support to law firm and in-house prospects.

Harvey’s Legal Engineers are skilled lawyers from top-tier law firms who apply their legal experience to ensure that current and prospective customers understand how Harvey’s solutions enhance specific day-to-day workflows, working alongside Harvey’s Account Executives to support all aspects of our sales strategy. Legal Engineers build consultative relationships with law firm partners and associates and in-house attorneys at private equity firms and Fortune 500 companies, becoming trusted advisors on how Harvey’s AI solutions can make them more effective.

Similar to the way Solutions Architects secure the “technical win” in the sales process, Legal Engineers secure the “legal win” by performing in-depth customer discovery and education on Harvey’s solutions through targeted meetings and demos that resonate with the customer’s day-to-day workflows specific to their legal practice area.

Legal Engineers utilize their experience practicing law and their legal mindset to ask thoughtful questions to understand the needs of law firm and in-house attorneys, develop credibility, and then partner with Account Executives to educate them on Harvey’s value via large and small group sessions as well as one-to-one conversations.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Legal Engineers, setting clear performance expectations and building a high-trust, high-output team culture

  • Own the quality and consistency of Harvey's pre-sales legal engineering function, ensuring demos, discovery conversations, and deal support are delivered to the highest standard

  • Partner closely with Account Executives and GTM leadership to prioritise pipeline, develop deal strategy, and support conversion on complex or strategic opportunities

  • Engage with lawyers at prospective customers to understand and address their workflow challenges

  • Collaborate with Product and Marketing to ensure the team's field insights are feeding into positioning, roadmap, and go-to-market strategy

  • Lead product demonstrations tailored to the context of various law firm practice groups and in-house legal teams, asking questions to validate how Harvey can add value and then showcasing Harvey’s features and benefits relevant to each prospective client’s potential use cases.

  • Act as the “Voice of the Customer,” using your legal perspective to help the broader sales team to develop and implement more effective strategies and synthesize customer feedback for the product team through a legal lens.

  • Travel may be required from time to time, including visits to customer office locations and company offices.


What You Have

  • Qualified lawyer with 7+ PQE, with experience in a law firm or in-house legal environment

  • Must have prior experience managing a team, with a track record of developing talent and driving performance

  • Deep familiarity with legal technology and AI tools, with an ability to quickly develop and demonstrate platform expertise

  • Strong commercial instincts and the ability to engage credibly with senior stakeholders at law firms and in-house legal teams

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience running training, workshops, or client-facing product sessions

  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a pragmatic, solutions-oriented approach

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

your mission:

You will be pivotal to telli’s growth. Your mission is to drive revenue by building trusted relationships with enterprise customers and closing complex, high-value deals (€100k+ land deal size). As one of the first Sr. Enterprise AEs at telli, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we win, navigate, and scale our enterprise sales motion.

 

what you'll do:

  • Own complex enterprise deals end-to-end: Lead €100k+ deals from first discovery through signature, including demos, business cases, security reviews, procurement, legal, contract negotiations, and executive alignment. You uncover where telli creates measurable value and build the case to make it a priority.

  • Build and own your pipeline: Our SDR team supports you, but you can generate own Enterprise pipeline. You identify the right accounts, develop account strategies, write outbound, make the calls, and create opportunities where none existed before.

  • Navigate complex buying committees: Build relationships across Sales, Operations, CX, IT, Security, Legal, Procurement, Finance, and the C-Suite at large organizations. You identify champions, understand internal politics, and create consensus across multiple stakeholders.

  • Run strategic, multi-threaded sales processes: You don't rely on a single champion. You map the organization, understand who influences the decision, and build relationships at multiple levels long before procurement enters the process.

  • Own a quota and close €100k+ deals: Drive meaningful new ARR and take full accountability for your forecast, pipeline coverage, and revenue target.

  • Build compelling business cases: Translate telli's product into measurable commercial impact for the customer and make the ROI clear enough to win internal budget and executive sponsorship.

  • Bring the customer into the company: Feed structured insights back into product, marketing, and strategy. You sit closest to some of our most important prospects and customers, and your signal helps shape what we build next.

 

what makes you a great fit:

  • You have 3+ years of experience closing enterprise deals: You have proven experience owning complex €100k+ sales cycles and selling to senior and C-Suite economic buyers.

  • You know how to navigate complexity: You've worked through long sales cycles involving multiple departments, procurement, security, legal, and competing internal priorities, without losing control of the deal.

  • You're an elite relationship builder: You know the difference between a contact, a champion, and an economic buyer. You build trust quickly and have won deals because of the relationships you created across an organization.

  • You're a hunter: You know how to manufacture pipeline without relying on a warm inbound stream. You're comfortable breaking into large accounts and creating urgency from scratch.

  • You have executive presence: You can hold your own with C-Suite stakeholders from the first interaction. You communicate clearly, challenge thoughtfully, and earn credibility quickly.

  • You think strategically about accounts: You don't just run meetings, you map stakeholders, identify blockers, understand incentives, and continuously think about what needs to happen for the deal to move forward.

  • You're commercially sharp: You understand how to build a business case, quantify value, negotiate confidently, and protect deal quality while getting complex agreements across the line.

  • You're obsessively prepared: You know more about the prospect's business, priorities, and challenges than they expect you to. Every interaction has a purpose.

  • You're low ego and high accountability: You're not above doing the grunt work. You take ownership when things go wrong, act on feedback quickly, and share credit when things go right.

  • You speak business-level German and English

  • You want to work on-site 5 days a week in Berlin

 

you may not be a good fit if:

  • You wait for pipeline to be handed to you. Sr. Enterprise AE means you generate

  • You need detailed instructions and shy away from taking responsibility

  • You only show up for the "strategic" parts of the deal and skip the procurement/security-review grunt work

  • You've never personally carried a quota or closed deals end-to-end

  • You want to work remotely. We're an in-person team

  • You think this role looks like a 9-to-5 job

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. About the Role

We’re hiring a hands-on Security Lead to strengthen the security of Langdock’s product, infrastructure, and internal systems.

Your primary focus will be application and infrastructure security. You’ll work closely with our CTO and engineering teams to identify risks, assess our defenses, and drive practical improvements. You’ll coordinate penetration tests, triage incoming vulnerability reports, and make sure findings turn into lasting fixes. You should be comfortable getting into technical details, challenging assumptions, and helping engineers choose the right controls.

You’ll also own the security of our internal IT environment, including identity, access, and device security. We’re looking for someone who builds reliable, automated processes and can judge whether our protections are effective.

Alongside this technical work, you’ll help explain our security posture to customers and support our compliance efforts. The foundation of this role is making Langdock secure; audits and customer assessments should reflect that work.

What You Will Do

The role's responsibility will span over multiple fields, which are:

Application security

  • Coordinate penetration tests end to end. Define scope with engineering and external testing partners, support testing, assess findings, and follow remediation through to verification.

  • Own vulnerability intake and triage. Monitor our security inbox and responsible disclosure program, assess reported issues, and work with engineering to prioritize and resolve them.

  • Help engineering build securely. Review security-sensitive designs and changes, identify weaknesses in areas such as authentication, authorization, and data isolation, and recommend practical improvements.

Infrastructure security

  • Assess and improve our security posture. Work with engineering to evaluate how our production infrastructure and internal systems are protected, identify gaps, and drive improvements.

  • Strengthen network and access controls. Review network separation, service exposure, privileged access, and permissions so systems and data are accessible only where needed.

  • Verify that controls work in practice. Look beyond configuration checklists to understand how systems could be compromised and whether our protections would prevent or detect it.

Internal security and automation

  • Own identity and device security. Ensure we have effective MFA, appropriate access policies, and properly managed, encrypted, and patched devices.

  • Automate the employee lifecycle. Build dependable processes for account provisioning, access changes, offboarding, and access reviews across Entra ID and our internal tools.

  • Keep recurring work manageable. Use scripts, integrations, and AI tooling to automate security operations and surface issues that need attention.

Customer assurance and compliance

  • Support customer security assessments. Help answer questionnaires and join customer conversations that require a clear, technically credible explanation of our security controls.

title: Expert Model Trains
description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

  • Taking ownership and driving impact 
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

Your Mission

As a Model Trains Expert, your mission is to bring your specialist model trains expertise to the curation of high-quality, compelling auctions that attract engaged collectors and trusted sellers. Your knowledge of brands, rarity, condition, valuation, and collector expectations is central to ensuring each lot is relevant, accurately assessed, and commercially strong.

By combining deep category expertise with sound commercial judgement, you play a key role in growing the Model Trains category, maintaining transparency, and strengthening trust within the collector community.

What You’ll Do

  • Evaluate and arrange model train lots submitted by users, ensuring each auction features attractive and relevant listings
  • Create compelling weekly lot selections using your expertise and professional network
  • Review titles, descriptions, and images to assess quality and provide accurate estimated values
  • Safeguard transparent and fair transactions through consistent expert evaluation
  • Communicate rejections professionally and diplomatically, maintaining strong seller relationships
  • Collaborate with Sales to attract new sellers and diversify the range and quality of lots
  • Partner with Marketing to increase bidder engagement and visibility for your auctions

What You’ll Bring

  • Expert knowledge in Model Trains
  • Strong commercial acumen and documented commercial experience
  • An eye for trade and value within the collectibles market
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to act diplomatically in user disputes
  • A network of potential sellers and experts within your field
  • Good computer skills and confidence working with digital tools
  • Good command of English, written and spoken

Where You’ll Be

This is a 100% remote role that can be based in the Netherlands, Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, Portugal, Spain, or the United Kingdom.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

  • Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
  • Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
  • A culture of connection defines us. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
  • Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion”. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Our Offices and Way of Working

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

Interested?

Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

raw.title: Head of Brand Marketing
raw.description:
📍 London (Hybrid – 2 days in office, 3 days remote/wfh or office if you prefer!)

Two in five people in the UK rent their homes. At Goodlord, our mission is to be the gold standard platform for renting - simplifying complexity across agents, landlords and tenants.

We’re looking for a hands-on Head of Brand Marketing to own how Goodlord shows up in the world - from our brand and content to PR, corporate affairs, thought leadership and the conversations shaping the future of renting.

You’ll be a brilliant brand and communications operator who can set direction while staying close to the work. Someone who enjoys shaping stories, building a distinctive brand, working with the media, developing great content and making sure everything we put into the world feels unmistakably Goodlord.

Reporting directly to our Marketing Director, you’ll lead a talented team of four across content, SEO and design, manage our external PR agency, and work closely with colleagues across Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Sales and the wider business.

You’ll help make Goodlord a distinctive and trusted voice in the rental industry, turning complex topics - from regulation and policy to AI and technology - into stories people actually want to read, hear and talk about. And you’ll make sure our brand doesn’t just look and sound great, but supports our wider commercial goals too.

If you like autonomy, pace and variety - and you’re comfortable being the person who both shapes what great looks like and helps make it happen - this could be a great fit!


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

The pace we move at means no two days are the same, but core responsibilities include:

Brand & storytelling

  • Own and evolve Goodlord’s brand strategy, positioning, identity and voice

  • Make sure our brand shows up consistently and distinctively across everything we do

  • Turn complex topics into clear, engaging stories that resonate with our customers and the wider market

  • Set the bar for great storytelling, creative quality and commercial impact

PR, media & corporate affairs

  • Own our PR and media activity across property, technology and business press

  • Build strong relationships with journalists and identify opportunities for Goodlord to lead and shape relevant conversations

  • Brief and manage our external PR agency, ensuring clear priorities and strong output

  • Lead our approach to corporate affairs, including regulatory and policy-related communications

  • Bring calm, credible judgement to reactive issues and sensitive moments, protecting Goodlord’s reputation while staying true to our voice and values

Content, SEO & thought leadership

  • Set the direction for our content across blogs, opinion pieces, insight-led content, case studies, social and video

  • Lead and develop our content and SEO team, making sure we’re creating useful, engaging work that supports wider marketing and business priorities

  • Shape our thought-leadership agenda around the topics that matter most to Goodlord and our customers - from regulation and compliance to AI, technology and the future of renting

  • Partner with senior leaders on commentary, bylines and external positioning, including ghostwriting and editing where needed

  • Help build the external profiles of our leadership team through media opportunities, speaking engagements, opinion pieces and awards

Creative & design

  • Lead our in-house design team, responsible for customer-facing collateral, tools, campaigns and video

  • Make sure everything we put into the world feels on-brand, well-crafted and commercially sharp

  • Work with the team to turn ideas into brilliant creative execution

Team & commercial impact

  • Lead, support and develop a team of four across content, SEO and design

  • Work closely with Demand Generation, Product Marketing and Sales to make sure brand, PR and content support wider commercial goals

  • Use data and insight to understand what’s working and where we can have greater impact

  • Build strong relationships across Goodlord, bringing together different teams, ideas and priorities to tell better stories

ABOUT YOU

You’ll be well suited to this role if you:

  • Have strong commercial experience across brand, PR/communications and content - in Agency and/or B2B tech, SaaS, fintech, proptech.

  • Have owned a brand, shaping its positioning, messaging, identity and how it shows up in market

  • Have experience directly leading and developing individual contributors across content, creative, design or communications

  • Are a strong storyteller with sound strategic judgement, able to zoom out to brand strategy and zoom in to a single headline

  • Have a track record of building media relationships and delivering coverage across both trade and mainstream press

  • Can translate complex regulation, technology or industry change into engaging, relatable stories

  • Have experience of corporate affairs and reputation or issues management, with the judgement to handle sensitive moments calmly and credibly

  • Are fluent in thought leadership and executive communications - from ghostwriting and bylines to presentations and media commentary

  • Have led and developed people across content, creative, design or communications

  • Understand SEO as a growth channel and know enough to set direction, ask the right questions and challenge specialists

  • Are commercially minded and naturally think about how brand, PR and content can support wider business goals

  • Are collaborative, comfortable working with different stakeholders and happy operating at pace

  • Enjoy having ownership while still being close to the work - you’re happy setting the direction, but equally comfortable rolling your sleeves up when needed

WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT HERE

You’ll have real ownership of how Goodlord shows up in the market

  • You’ll get to work across brand, PR, content and creative rather than being boxed into one discipline

  • You’ll lead a talented team across content, SEO and design

  • You’ll work on genuinely interesting topics at a time of huge change in the rental industry

  • You’ll have plenty of autonomy to turn good ideas into action

  • You’ll be joining a purpose-driven team reshaping one of the UK’s most important industries

  • You’ll be part of a culture that believes in Letting Without Limits - for our customers, our partners and our people

This role is about owning delivery, not building a large function. If you’re looking for a purely strategic communications role with a sizeable team underneath you, this probably isn’t the right fit. If you enjoy being close to the work and making things happen, we’d love to hear from you!

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

  • Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

  • Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

  • 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

  • Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

  • Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

A full job spec is available on request.

Goodlord wants applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life; we are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment.

Creating a space where everyone feels included is central to who we are. Because we're an open book and we learn from each other, we actively champion diverse perspectives and unique life experiences. If there is anything you need to participate fully in the interview process, we'd love to hear about that too - please include it in your application.


** Please note, as we are regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority, all Goodlordians are required to pass a thorough referencing check via Experian before joining the team. We will only ask for references at the point of making an offer.

No agencies please - we have tried and trusted partners we would turn to should we require support.

🌟 Position: Senior Cost Manager 🌟

📍 Location: 3 Days Office (London) /2 days hybrid

💼 Type: Full-time

📅 Start Date: Immediate

💰 Salary: Competitive

 

We are currently seeking an experienced Senior Cost Manager to join our dynamic award winning team. Our client is delivering one of the most complex and high-profile infrastructure programmes in the UK today. Backed by UK Government and key industry stakeholders, the organisation is entering a pivotal phase of development: securing funding, finalising strategic partnerships across the supply chain, and laying the regulatory groundwork to advance into full-scale construction.

As a Senior Cost Manager, you’ll be at the heart of a nationally significant transport programme that will reshape connectivity across the UK. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a landmark infrastructure project from the inside out—driving value, ensuring commercial rigour, and helping deliver one of the most ambitious rail initiatives in British history.

 

About us: CMR is an award winning project controls consultancy that is first and foremost a team of people, passionate about the construction industry and changing the way project controls is provided. Our approach and culture have been recognised globally, with CMR named Global Project Controls Small Business of the Year 2025 (Project Controls Expo UK Awards) and one of the UK’s Best Workplaces in 2026 (Great Place to Work)

Our Purpose (Why we exist): Inspiring new ways to help shape our construction industry.

Our Ambition (What we want to achieve): Re-imagine project controls through a digital lens, being the obvious choice for clients and the place to grow together with intention.

 

🔹 What’s in it for you?

• At CMR you will have the opportunity to professionally develop like nowhere you have worked before.

• If you demonstrate the capability, our merit-based system will enable you to develop fast.

• We use our in-house capability matrix to transparently track your progression and highlight development areas.

• Join our small, dynamic team where every member has the chance to make a significant impact, shaping the future direction of our company and making a real difference.

• We believe in rewarding our team for their achievements, celebrating our successes but equally helping each other when things are tough.

 

🔹 You'll

Team Leadership & Collaboration

  • Support the Cost Lead in driving integrated cost control practices across the Civil Works Programme.

  • Coach and guide team members within the Cost Discipline

  • Collaborate with other Project Controls disciplines and support functions to ensure aligned project delivery.

Cost Management & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate cost forecasts and actuals within the financial control system (EcoSys).

  • Oversee monthly cost reporting cycles including Actual Cost of Work Performed (ACWP), Earned Value Analysis, and Estimates at Completion (EAC).

  • Ensure all changes are reflected accurately within budgets and forecasts.

  • Review and integrate estimates from Tier 1 contractors and suppliers.

Analysis & Insight

  • Conduct cost performance analysis and identify areas of risk or opportunity.

  • Ensure earned value techniques are correctly implemented across the programme.

  • Support the development and optimisation of cost reporting systems.

 

🔹 We’re looking for:

Essential

  • Demonstrated leadership capability in cost or commercial functions.

  • Deep understanding of cost management methodologies and earned value analysis.

  • Strong grasp of engineering, procurement, and construction processes.

  • High-level analytical and numerical ability with attention to detail.

  • Experience with cost management tools such as EcoSys.

  • Familiarity with NEC or FIDIC contract frameworks.

  • Commercially astute with excellent interpersonal skills.

Desirable

  • Familiarity with scheduling (Primavera P6) and risk tools (ARM).

  • Experience working on complex major infrastructure projects.

  • Ability to communicate and present financial insights to senior stakeholders.

  • Previous experience in the nuclear or regulated infrastructure sector.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree in Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Construction, Accounting or related discipline (or equivalent project experience).

  • Chartered or equivalent professional status preferred.

  • Proven track record in cost management within a major project environment.

 

🔹 At CMR we have a strong culture driven by our 9 Core Principles. We look to build a community of people that share our values and ambitions. We’re proud that 96% of our team say CMR is a “Great Place to Work” a reflection of our supportive culture, focus on people, and drive to do things differently.

• 👉 Learn more here: https://cmr.london/who-we-are/

 

📍 Requirements and Location:

• Full right to work in the UK

• 3 Days in London Office / 2 days hybrid

 

📦 Salary & Benefits

• 25 days holiday (plus Bank Holidays)

• Comprehensive Private Healthcare (Inc Dentist and Optician)

• Life Assurance (x4 Salary)

• Pension: employers' contribution of 4%

• Company and personal performance-based bonus

• Salary Sacrifice Scheme

• Long Service Leave

• Training and professional development

• Regular social events

• Perkbox – employee experience platform

What This Role Is Not • It is not a traditional marketing leadership job. • It is not an MQL, impressions, content-calendar, or brand-campaign role. • It is not a decision to hire SDR, demand-gen, content, and marketing-ops teams before product-market evidence exists. • It is not ownership of OpenVPN growth. Rod, Head of Growth, owns the established-business growth mandate; This role is focused on Cipherscale zero-to-one GTM and must collaborate cleanly without duplicating authority. Important: This is a full-time remote job, and it will be a long-term B2B contract. This can be a permanent employment opportunity for candidates based in Spain, Poland, and Germany. Our philosophy is that we are a small, close-knit team, and we care deeply about you: Highly competitive salary + Bonus Fully remote work environments. Self-managed time off. Who We Want • You have personally helped take a deeply technical B2B security, infrastructure, identity, developer, cloud, or AI product from near-zero to repeatable initial revenue. • You can sit with a CISO, CTO, security architect, platform engineer, and AI-platform leader and earn credibility. • You understand enough security architecture to reason about identity, delegated authority, credentials, policy, enforcement, trust boundaries, auditability, and blast radius. • You are comfortable selling before there is a polished playbook and learning directly from rejection. • You treat AI as operating leverage. Your instinct is to build agentic workflows before asking for headcount. • You are analytical enough to distinguish activity from evidence and evidence from causality. • You are comfortable challenging the CEO and product assumptions when customer evidence disagrees. Strong Background Signals • Early-stage Zero Trust, identity, cloud security, developer security, infrastructure security, AI security, developer infrastructure, or adjacent enterprise-security categories. • Founder, first-GTM, product-led commercial operator, technical seller, or hands-on GTM executive backgrounds can all fit. • Large-company titles alone are not compelling. How Success Is Measured • Business: paid customers, initial ARR/MRR, expansion and eventually defensible unit economics. • Customer: time-to-first-value, production activation, repeated authorized usage, protected resources/principals, retention and expansion. • Funnel: qualified conversations -> design partners -> deployments -> production -> paid -> expansion. • Learning velocity: experiment cycle time, evidence quality, speed at which weak assumptions are killed or corrected. Operating Model and Reporting This role works directly with the CEO during zero-to-one discovery and partners closely with Rod, Head of Growth. Decision rights will be explicit: CipherScale market discovery cannot become an overlapping second growth organization, and OpenVPN growth priorities cannot dilute CipherScale category discovery. As the motion becomes repeatable, responsibilities can be consolidated based on evidence rather than titles. Security Expectations You will operate with customer and prospect data, AI agents, email/CRM systems, call transcripts, and potentially technical environments. Treat agents as potentially compromised actors. Use scoped identities, least privilege, deterministic authorization for external actions, credential isolation, customer-data boundaries, prompt-injection defenses, audit trails, and human approval for high-impact commitments until explicitly delegated. Compensation Philosophy We would rather pay exceptional compensation and meaningful upside for one outstanding founder-level operator than assemble a large conventional GTM organization. Final structure should reflect experience, location, scope, and demonstrated ability to create zero-to-one enterprise value. The Test A strong candidate should be able to take the Cipherscale thesis, identify the first market to attack, design the first ten customer experiments, explain what evidence would invalidate the strategy, and show how they would use AI to execute the work with minimal human headcount. title: Teamleiter Last Mile Logistik (m/w/d)
description:
Kurz und Knapp

 

Du liebst die tägliche Abwechslung, siehst dich als (zukünftige) Führungskraft, um dein Team zum Erfolg zu führen, und bist bereit für eine neue Herausforderung in der Logistik?

Dann bist du bei Picnic genau richtig! Denn wir suchen nach einer Teamleitung für unseren Last Mile Standort (Hub) in München. Die Hubs werden mit unseren bereits fertig kommissionierten Waren aus dem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) beliefert und sind als Verteilzentrum die letzte Station unserer Logistikkette, bevor die Einkäufe beim Kunden auf dem Küchentisch landen.

 

Das erwartet dich 

 

  • Teamführung: Stelle dein Team ein und coache es zum Erfolg. Du kannst auch tolle Events planen, um den Zusammenhalt weiter zu stärken.
  • Entwicklung zur Führungskraft: Du managst nicht nur die Schichtpläne, sondern übernimmst die Einarbeitung und Entwicklung der Runner (Fahrer) in einem unserer Hubs, und sorgst so dafür, dass alles rund läuft.
  • Liefermanagement: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung, wenn die Lkw mit frischen Waren ankommen, und sorgst dafür, dass alles passt! Und wenn etwas fehlt, organisierst du blitzschnell Nachlieferungen – du behältst immer den Überblick über doe Logistik in deinem Standort.
  • Prozessmanagement: Du hältst den Betrieb am Laufen durch einen kontinuierlich den Fokus auf unsere betrieblichen Kennzahlen (KPIs) und garantierst, dass alles sicher und wie am Schnürchen läuft, ganz nach unserem Motto: “Safety First”.
  • Teamwork: Im engen Austausch mit dem Customer-Success Team, unserem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) und anderen Hubs machst du unsere Kunden glücklich.
  • Pünktliche Abfahrten: Dank dir sind unsere Fahrer immer pünktlich unterwegs zu unseren Kunden, damit wir unser versprochenes Zeitfenster einhalten können.
  • Bringe deine Ideen ein: Von der Koordination der Reparatur unserer Elektrofahrzeuge über die Gestaltung des Hub Layouts bis hin zur Rekrutierung unserer Runner - deine Ideen tragen dazu bei, dass wir gemeinsam weiter wachsen können und unsere Logistikprozesse auf ein neues Level bringen.

 

 

Das bringst du mit 

  • Ein Studium oder abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung in der Logistik, dem Einzelhandel oder in ähnlichen Bereichen. 
  • Erste Erfahrungen in der Führung von Teams - entweder im Beruf oder du hast bereits ein anderes Erfolgsteam gecoached.
  • Fließende Deutsch- und basic Englischkenntnisse.
  • Du bist im Besitz eines gültigen Führerscheins der Klasse B.
  • Gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten und ein selbstbewusstes Auftreten.
  • Du magst es, Entscheidungen auf Grundlage von Zahlen und Fakten zu treffen. 

 

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.
  • Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. In unseren Hubs steht dir jederzeit ein gut gefüllter Kühlschrank mit frischen Snacks, Getränken und Obst zur Verfügung – damit du bestens versorgt bist, wenn dich der Hunger packt.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Individuelle Mobilität: Du entscheidest, wie du zu uns kommst. Wir bieten ein subventioniertes Deutschlandticket und ein „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm an.
  • Lerne & wachse: Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.

Bereit für die Herausforderung? Dann bewirb dich, werde Teil des Picnic Teams und hilf uns dabei, zum besten Milchmann in Deutschland zu werden!

title: Senior CRM Lifecycle + Journeys Manager
description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE 

The Senior Manager, CRM Lifecycle + Journeys owns every triggered flow in the customer journey across email, SMS, push, and in-app for UK, Germany, and France. You will build the automation engine that runs Quince's retention programme: from the welcome series a UK customer sees the day we launch, to the win-back flow that recovers a French customer six months later.

This is a builder role. You will spend most of your first six months in Iterable and the CDP. You will write the flow logic, set up the data pipes, design the experiments, and ship the AI agents that take work out of building, testing, and reporting on flows. The Director, CRM owns the retention strategy and the campaign calendar. You own the triggered flow programme that runs alongside it.

Two constraints shape this job. UK and EU privacy rules mean the US lifecycle playbook does not transfer unchanged: you will rebuild the identity-resolution layer and shift weight toward logged-in and app behaviour. Channel economics also differ across markets, with SMS in particular materially more expensive in Europe than in the US, so the sequencing of email, SMS, push, and in-app per flow per market is not the same as the US default.

You will be joining a team that values speed, candor, and rigour. This role is for you if you like building things, you can hold a roadmap in one hand and a SQL query in the other, and you have an opinion on how AI changes lifecycle work over the next 18 months.

Responsibilities

  • Build, launch, and own every triggered lifecycle flow for UK (July 2026), DE (October 2026), and FR (November 2026): welcome, browse abandon, cart abandon, post-purchase, low stock, back in stock, win-back, replenishment, care instructions.
  • Partner with MarTech to Ship AI agents and tooling that take work out of flow build, copy, segmentation, and QA. Target at least one end-to-end CRM agent in production by EoY1 and a 50% reduction in flow concept-to-deployment time within 90 days.
  • Partner with the Data team to run the triggered-flow testing roadmap with statistically sound design. Minimum 6 A/B tests per quarter per flow per market.
  • Build channel-cost decision logic across email, SMS, push, and in-app per flow per market.
  • Recover signal lost from fingerprinting and consent restrictions in UK/EU by pushing app and logged-in routing for non-consenting users.
  • Stand up and run the localisation pipeline with freelance copywriters for EN-UK, DE, and FR. Localised flow content live before each market launch.
  • Partner with tech team to maintain CDP quality across UK/EU: data model, integrations (Iterable, Attentive, app SDK, site events), data hygiene, latency, and identity-resolution accuracy.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years lifecycle/CRM marketing in DTC or ecommerce, including at least 3 years owning automated/triggered flows end to end (not campaign/blast).
  • Hands-on with Iterable (preferred), or comparable ESP (Braze, Klaviyo, SFMC). Must have built flows in the tool, not just briefed them.
  • Hands-on with a CDP: Segment, mParticle, Hightouch, Census, or similar. Must understand identity resolution and data hygiene.
  • Has built or deployed AI agents or LLM workflows in a marketing context (copy, segmentation, flow logic, QA). If you have not shipped one yet, you can describe the one you would ship in your first 90 days here.
  • SQL proficient. Can self-serve in Looker, Lookr, or BigQuery without waiting for an analyst.
  • A/B testing rigour. Knows what statistical significance means and where it breaks in lifecycle (sample size, primary metric selection, novelty effects).
  • Working knowledge of UK/EU privacy law (GDPR, PECR) and consent management. Understands what changes operationally when fingerprinting is restricted.
  • Detail-oriented. Triggered flows live or die on edge cases (locale, currency, time zone, opt-in state, suppression rules).
  • Strong cross-functional operator. Will work daily with creative, brand, data science, tech, and US CRM counterparts.

Preferred: 

  • Multi-market lifecycle experience (UK + DE or FR), fashion or home goods background, app-native lifecycle experience, fluency in DE or FR.

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range
£80,000—£90,000 GBP

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

As our founding Account Executive for the Dutch market, you'll be the first commercial hire dedicated to the Netherlands. You'll own the full sales cycle end to end, from qualifying inbound demand through to close, while helping shape how we sell in the Dutch market as you go. Processes aren't fully built yet, and you'll be part of building them up.

Who We Want

Strong communicator.
You're a native Dutch speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Self-confident.
You believe in your ability to run and close a conversation without coming across as arrogant.

Comfortable with ambiguity.
You're energized, not unsettled, by the fact that not everything is defined yet. You'd rather help build the process than be handed one.

Coachable.
You take direct feedback without getting defensive, and visibly apply it in your next conversation.

Resilient.
You bounce back quickly from a lost deal or a tough week and keep your activity levels consistently high.

Fast learner.
You get up to speed on a technical product quickly and can explain it to customers in a way they understand.

Structured.
You keep your pipeline clean and your CRM notes reliable, without anyone having to chase you

Who We Don't Want

Gets defensive with feedback.
You take direct feedback personally instead of applying it, and repeat the same mistakes call after call.

Weak written communication.
You struggle to express yourself clearly and professionally in writing, whether that's emails, CRM notes, or follow-ups.

In it for the paycheck alone.
You're chasing the salary with no genuine interest in the craft of selling, and it shows in how little curiosity you bring to the work.

Uncomfortable being first.
You'd rather join an established team than be the one setting the tone for how the Dutch market gets sold.

Your Day To Day

Demos & Product Presentation (~80%)

  • You convince prospects to join a product demo and book the relevant appointments
  • You present Superchat's capabilities convincingly and show customers how the product solves their specific challenges

Closing (~20%)

  • You convince prospects to sign a contract and successfully guide the sales cycle through to close
  • You flag patterns in objections or lost deals so the sales process keeps improving as we learn

Stakeholders

Customers: your most important point of contact day-to-day - from first outreach through demos to close
Sales Team: for joint training, knowledge-sharing, and exchanging best practices across the sales cycle
Customer Success Team: for handover after a successful close and a smooth start to onboarding

Why People Choose Us

  • We believe in the power of in-person collaboration: We're an in-office culture at heart - we genuinely love being together in the Berlin office. That's where the best ideas happen, decisions move faster, and we learn from and grow with each other every day. We do offer some flexibility for remote work, but our default and our energy is being in the room together.
  • We're an international team with diverse cultural backgrounds and languages. Openness, mutual respect, and the exchange of different perspectives shape the way we work together.
  • We value ambition and drive. We're looking for people who take ownership, show initiative, and are excited to grow quickly.
  • We work with a high degree of ownership and a strong learning mindset. Asking questions, staying curious, and continuously improving are part of our everyday culture.
  • We care deeply about humility and teamwork. No egos, open feedback, and a willingness to learn from one another matter more to us than titles.

Benefits & Culture

  • Choose between an Urban Sports Club or John Reed membership, or a public transport pass/Dance subscription.
  • Regular company-wide and team events.
  • An annual €500 learning and development budget that you can use for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more.
  • An inclusive and exciting startup culture that supports rapid professional and personal growth.
  • A beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment.

We want to build a community, not just a company.

Creating an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together is important to us - whether that's through HYROX training, golf, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or any other community you'd like to build here.

Why ARTEFACT?
